senses.gloss: बध-काम्या बध-काम्या, f. intention to hurt, Man. 4, 165.

बध् बध्,
 1. See हन्.
 2. See बन्ध्.
 3. See बीभत्स.

बाध् बाध्, or वाध् वाध् (akin to बध्, see हन्), i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To repel, Chr. 294, 5 = Rigv. i. 92, 5.
 2. To oppose.
 3. To remove, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 7.
 4. To annoy, Hit. 57, 5; to grieve, Man. 10, 129; Pañc. 31, 10; pass. To suffer, ii. d. 95.
 5. To torment, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2220 (= Hit. ii. d. 102, but cf. 1. 1.).
 6. To damage, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 7.
 --Ptcple. of [] the pf. pass. बाधित,
 1. Obstructed.
 2. Pained.
 3. Self-refuted, contradictory, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 7.
 --Caus. To annoy, Rām. 1, 14, 15.
 --With अधि अधि, To annoy, MBh. 1, 5693.
 --With अनु अनु, To pain, Rājat. 5, 442.
 --With अप अप, To repel, Chr. 291, 3 = Rigv. i. 85, 3.
 --With आ आ, To restrain, Śāk. Chezy. 58, 10.
 --With परि परि, To annoy, MBh. 3, 8743; to importune, Śāk. d. 184.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To repel, MBh. 2, 1648.
 2. To throw down, Pañc. i. d. 183.
 3. To destroy, i. d. 455.
 4. To annoy, Rām. 2, 53, 15.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To repel, Rām. 2, 52, 46.
 2. To restrain, MBh. 3, 1081.
बध बध, बधक बधक, see वध, वधक.

बाध बाध् + अ, or वाध वाध,
 I. m.
 1. Opposing.
 2. Being precluded by superior evidence (one of the five forms of fallacious middle term), Bhāṣāp. 77.
 3. Annoyance.
 4. Damage, Yājñ. 2, 156.
 5. Danger, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3136.
 II. f. धा.
 1. Refutation.
 2. Annoyance, affliction, pain, Gīt. 1, 26.
 --Comp.
बधत्र 1. बध् + अत्र, n. A weapon.
बधिर बधिर, probably बन्ध् + इर, adj. Deaf, Pañc. v. d. 84.
बधिरता बधिर + ता f. Deafness, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 831.

बध्र बध्र,
 I. n. Lead.
 II. (i. e. बन्ध् + र), f. री, A thong, MBh. 1, 1406.

बाधन बाध् + अन, n.
 1. Opposing.
 2. Refutation, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 11.
 3. Pain.
बाधितत्व बाधित + त्व, n. Condition of being contradicted, refuted, Vedāntas. in Chr. 211, 21.
बध्य- + भूमि बध्य- + भूमि (vb. वध्), f. place of execution, Hit. 63, 6.
बध्य- + शिला बध्य- + शिला, f. ला, rock of execution, Pañc. 52, 2.
बध्य- + स्थान बध्य- + स्थान, or वध्य- (vb. वध्), n. place of execution, Pañc. 41, 15.
